title: Find a tote location in RMS by typing the tote number in the container section
summary: Use the RMS / fleet status UI container section tote lookup to enter a tote number and navigate the map to where that tote is currently represented/added in the system.
when_to_use: When you need to locate where a specific tote is in the system so you can navigate the RMS map to that tote’s current location for follow-on recovery actions.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the tote lookup in RMS / fleet status UI and confirm the map navigates to the tote’s represented location.

access_required: Access to RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui)

visual_references.description: RMS container/rack area context showing container selection and tote/rack identification; includes the segment where tote lookup by typing tote number is described.

steps.title: Open RMS / fleet status UI and locate the container section tote lookup
steps.purpose: Get to the RMS container selection/container section that supports tote lookup by tote number.
steps.instruction: In the RMS / fleet status UI (map view), locate the container selection/container section that allows you to look up a tote by typing its tote number.
steps.expected_result: You are positioned in the RMS container section where a tote number can be entered for lookup.
steps.healthy_condition: The RMS container section is visible and ready for tote lookup input (tote number entry is available).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot find the container section that supports tote lookup input, or the UI does not provide a tote number entry field.

actions.label: Locate container section with tote lookup
actions.exact_action: Locate the container selection/container section that supports tote lookup.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “You can find a toad by typing the toad number on this container section, and it will take you to the part of the map where that toad's been added or wherever that toad is in the system.”

steps.title: Enter the tote number into the container section
steps.purpose: Provide the tote number to RMS so it can navigate the map to the tote’s represented location.
steps.instruction: Type the tote number into the tote number search/entry field in the container section.
steps.expected_result: The tote number is entered into the container section tote lookup field.
steps.healthy_condition: The tote number entry field accepts the tote number you intend to locate.
steps.failure_condition: The tote number cannot be entered/accepted, or the entry field is not present.

actions.label: Type tote number
actions.exact_action: Type the toad number on this container section

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “You can find a toad by typing the toad number on this container section…”

steps.title: Submit/confirm the tote lookup so the map navigates
steps.purpose: Trigger RMS to navigate the map to the tote’s location in the system.
steps.instruction: Submit/confirm the tote number entry (if the UI requires an action) so the map navigates to the tote’s location.
steps.expected_result: RMS updates the map view in response to the tote lookup submission.
steps.healthy_condition: After submission, the map begins navigating to the tote’s represented location.
steps.failure_condition: After submission, the map does not navigate (no location change).

actions.label: Submit/confirm lookup
actions.exact_action: Submit/confirm the entry (if the UI requires an action)

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “...it will take you to the part of the map where that toad's been added or wherever that toad is in the system.”

steps.title: Verify the map view moves to the tote’s location
steps.purpose: Confirm the lookup worked and the map is showing the tote’s represented location.
steps.instruction: Verify the map view moves to the part of the map where that tote is located/has been added.
steps.expected_result: The RMS map view is positioned at the tote’s represented location (where that tote has been added in the system).
steps.healthy_condition: The map navigates to the tote’s location associated with the tote number you entered.
steps.failure_condition: The map does not move to the expected tote location (no navigation to where the tote should be found).

actions.label: Confirm map navigation
actions.exact_action: Verify the map view moves to the part of the map where that tote is located/has been added.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the tote number does not take you to any location where the tote is expected to be found (possible incorrect tote association or missing tote state).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “...it will take you to the part of the map where that toad's been added or wherever that toad is in the system.”
“...it comes in handy because sometimes... there's an incorrect tote somewhere else. ...you type it in it will take you there...”

success_criteria: After entering a tote number and submitting (if required), RMS navigates the map to the part of the map where that tote is represented/added in the system.
healthy_conditions: Map navigation occurs and positions the view at the tote’s represented location corresponding to the entered tote number.
failure_conditions: Tote lookup does not navigate to any location where the tote is expected to be found, suggesting incorrect tote association or missing tote state.
escalation_guidance: If the tote lookup does not take you to the expected tote location, escalate for investigation of possible incorrect tote association or missing tote state.
